uncertainties.note: Rows 3310-3335 continue Mission 10A's combat: Amaterasu falls, Londo Bell (Amuro Ray, Renton, Garrod and allies) arrives and engages Neo Zeon/Giganos/coup forces including a funnel-using Cyber Newtype pilot. Speakers are untagged; 'Renton' and 'Garrod' are the only characters named by the source itself (rows 3330, 3334), so no other identity was assigned to the surrounding lines.

'強化人間' (kyouka ningen, lit. 'enhanced human') rendered 'Cyber Newtype' to match the project's existing description of this exact archetype for Gyunei Guss (character_names_021: 'Neo Zeon Cyber Newtype mobile suit pilot'). This is the term's first appearance in dialogue; recorded as a glossary proposal (batch_03310_glossary_proposals.json) so later batches use the same rendering rather than 'Enhanced Human'.

Rows 3336-3344 (<on()> radio chatter, undecided ship/side) and 3345-3365 (<on()> conference) shift to a debrief that reads as a joint bridge scene between the Nadesico B (Ruri, Harry) and the Gekko-Go (Talho, and by implication Holland/Eureka Seven crew); the source does not state which single ship this is, so no vessel name was added to any target. The closing line 3365 ('I'm coming along too, my post is gone anyway') is unattributed; contextually it may be the mercenary/contractor character introduced at rows 3252-3259, but this was not written into the target.

Several conference lines have no explicit subject in the source ('drew power', 'made off with it', 'this is worse than expected'); English supplies 'he'/'the enemy'/'this' only where the antecedent (Berkt, or the situation) is unambiguous from the immediately preceding line, per the no-invented-subject rule.
